message.subject: Re: Supply enquiry
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.5% (sc:70340@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 13.1% (fc:330020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

# New contact person

email - 2025-10-09 - Metallbau Steinfelder KG

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-04-18 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Metallbau Steinfelder KG said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-07-21 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Metallbau Steinfelder KG: he offered to walk us through their calculation (hourly rates and material) if that helps to settle prices.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-07-28 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Metallbau Steinfelder KG: he asked where we get our index figures from - he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.

# Steel for 2027

letter - 2026-10-13 - Metallbau Steinfelder KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

for your planning: we have secured our steel sheet and coil for 2027, bought forward at fixed prices with our mill. Whatever the steel market does reaches our prices only from 2028.

Yours faithfully,
Metallbau Steinfelder KG
